BiblicalUsage: The word appears once, at the end of the story of John's birth: the child grew, and waxed strong in spirit, and was in the deserts till the day of his shewing unto Israel. It is the showing itself — the day John came out of the wilderness and was presented to the nation he had come to prepare.
TheologicalSignificance: One word for a showing carries no doctrine of its own; its weight is the waiting — John growing strong in the desert until the day he was shown to Israel.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
